references.text: Instructions for making the menorah (lampstand) that Moses now places in the tabernacle
God's instruction that the lampstand should be placed on the south side of the tabernacle, opposite the table
The description of how Bezalel made the lampstand that is now being placed
The Levites' responsibility to care for the lampstand and other holy objects
Instructions on how the lamps on the lampstand were to be lit
Solomon placed ten lampstands in the temple, five on the south side and five on the north side
The book of Hebrews describes the lampstand as part of the Holy Place in the tabernacle
John sees seven golden lampstands in his vision, symbolically linked to the tabernacle's lampstand
The placement of the lampstand is illuminated directly by Leviticus' command for perpetual burning before the face of God.
